scope: Short read-only control-flow sampling of only these two root-authored files, while root assembles the controlled-link packet. Not a comprehensive review, runtime qualification or independent SDK build. No tests rerun or approval API.
checked: TCP echo success comes from exact received bytes; UDP additionally checks exact peer family/IP/port and length.
Guest PASS requires no sticky error, both actual echoes and both CLOSE states; owned FD closes and tty/flag restoration feed failure.
SPACE/LF is closed under every arbitrary suffix. Bridge authorizer requires the exact queued frame encoding, alphabet and cumulative cap; no TAB/control/command bytes.
CRC/session/direction/sequence and phase are validated; guest refuses partial bit/line/codec end at normal CLOSE.
Guest whole/close deadlines, bridge connect/queue/whole deadlines, bounded queues/frame counts, EOF/SHUT_WR/close errors were traced.
limits: Only the two named source files were read; isolated dispatch was not needed for this spot check.
No target/SSH/hardware/source edits, builds or GPU activity.
No full approval inferred from absence of a sampled blocker; root retains artifact/packet/runtime/recovery gates.
